name: Fraternity of Samos
description: A Pythagorean Mystery Cult organized into degrees that teach planetary, geometric and theurgic Virtues; its Inner Order members run publicly known Schools.

name: Electus
description: Third degree of the Fraternity of Samos, which teaches the esoteric principles of astrology and grants Planetary Magic.

name: Mathematikoi
description: The Inner Order of the Fraternity of Samos, robed in black or white, who abstain from meat and beans and must teach new Initiates.

name: Akousmatics
description: Members of the Fraternity of Samos below the Inner Order, who seek further knowledge and teaching at Schools.

name: Tertius
description: Fourth degree of the Fraternity of Samos dealing with metempsychosis and geometric solids, initiating Hermetic Architecture.

name: Secundus
description: Fifth degree of the Fraternity of Samos, rumored to teach Inscription on the Soul, Hermetic Theurgy or Theurgic Spirit Familiar.

name: Pythagorean (degree)
description: Final degree of the Fraternity of Samos, requiring a five-year vow of silence as a Major Ordeal.

name: Pythagoras
description: Ancient philosopher whose teachings, such as abstention from green beans because of metempsychosis, guide the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Metempsychosis
description: The transmigration of souls, a central teaching of the Pythagorean Mysteries.

name: Pythagorean Lore
description: Pythagorean teaching holding that three is the first real number and linking the elements to geometric solids.

name: School (Fraternity of Samos)
description: A covenant where a member of the Mathematikoi lives; it is publicly known as a focus for magi seeking Initiation.

name: Nativity Horoscope
description: The natal chart of an Electus Initiate, kept by the Initiators; together with a lock of hair it gives a Penetration bonus against the Initiate.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Ability that covers mundane astrology; the Pythagorean degree may teach Potent Magic focused on it.

name: Philosophiae
description: Ability valued by the Fraternity of Samos alongside Magic Theory and Teaching.

name: Teaching
description: Mundane ability that members of the Mathematikoi must have at 2 or higher.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability used in Fraternity standing and in rolls to rebind high-level spells into a talisman.

name: Planetary Magic
description: Virtue gained at the Electus degree of the Fraternity and taught to Green Stone Knights; replaces Hermetic Astrology in conversion.

name: Hermetic Architecture
description: Virtue initiated at the Tertius degree, based on geometric principles; replaces Fourth Edition Sacred Architecture.

name: Great Talisman
description: Virtue that some claim is taught at the Tertius degree of the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Performance Magic
description: Virtue of magic through performance; the Green Stone Knights call the Music form Sorcerous Poetry, and it replaces Sorcerous Music in conversion.

name: Inscription on the Soul
description: Virtue rumored to be taught at the Secundus degree and the fourth degree of the Disciples of the Worm; lets an immortal bind effects into a spirit talisman.

name: Hermetic Theurgy
description: Mystery magic for pacts with Daimons; Fourth Edition theurgy and thaumaturgy convert into it.

name: Theurgic Spirit Familiar
description: Virtue possibly taught at the Secundus degree of the Fraternity of Samos.

name: Potent Magic
description: Minor Virtue with specialized variants such as Artes Liberales and Philosophiae, Ghosts, Gemstones, or Dream; new in the Revised Edition.

name: Names of Power
description: Virtue possibly taught to Pythagoreans; Aneirin can teach names of minor spirits through a pact.

name: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
description: Virtue of freedom from metempsychosis and ascent to immortality as a Daimon.

name: Flawed Parma Magica
description: Flaw likened to the Arcane Connection weakness imposed at the Electus Initiation.

name: Limited Magic Resistance
description: Flaw compared with the Penetration vulnerability created at the Electus Initiation.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A link to a target; Initiators keep the Initiate's lock of hair as a permanent Arcane Connection.

name: Ordeal
description: A hardship in an Initiation Script that imposes a Flaw, such as a vow of silence; it cannot be used to initiate immortals.

name: Initiation Script
description: The structured sequence of quests, ordeals and sacrifices a Mystagogue uses to initiate a Virtue.

name: Mystagogue
description: The cult member who performs an Initiation; Presence and cult Lore contribute to the Script.

name: Initiation
description: The process by which Mystery Cults confer Virtues on members.

name: Mystery Cult
description: A secretive brotherhood of magi that teaches Mystery Virtues through Initiation.

name: Disciples of the Worm
description: A necromantic Mystery Cult founded by Vespillo that binds spirits into spells and seeks the tombs of ancient wizards.

name: Titus Herennius Vespillo
description: Tenth-century necromancer magus of Rome who pioneered Hermetic spirit magic and founded the Disciples of the Worm.

name: Julius of the Oder
description: Notorious Flambeau magus who joined Vespillo against hedge magicians and died in the catacombs of Rome.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House to which Julius of the Oder belonged.

name: Bellephon of Prague
description: Disciple of the Worm devoured by maggots in 1034 while the Quaesitors questioned him.

name: Pertinax of Tytalus
description: Necromancer and the only known member of the Worm cult; he acts as its contact with other cults.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigators who questioned accused Disciples of the Worm.

name: Worm Lore
description: The cult Lore of the Disciples of the Worm; a Mystagogue usually has 6 or more.

name: Hermetic Evocation
description: Secrets of the Disciples of the Worm, taught to second-degree Initiates as spell binding.

name: Spell Binding
description: Minor Virtue of the second Worm degree, which binds minor spirits or ghosts into spells to sustain them.

name: Second Sight
description: Supernatural Ability taught at the first Worm degree; it can perceive a discorporate Chnoubis.

name: Hermetic Empowerment
description: Virtue given at the third Worm degree to those who force a secret from a spirit in a pagan tomb.

name: Living Ghost
description: Major Virtue of the seventh Worm degree; the magus is ritually killed and bound as a ghost to the cult.

name: Transformation of the Living Ghost
description: Ritual of the Living Ghost that can be repeated to raise Might Score.

name: Spirit familiar
description: A familiar that is an immortal disembodied spirit, taught at the sixth Worm degree and needing no extra vis when its magus becomes immortal.

name: Hermetic spirit magic
description: School of magic for binding spirits and ghosts, pioneered by Vespillo and new in the Revised Edition.

name: Ghost
description: Spirits of the dead that the Disciples of the Worm bind; wounds from other ghosts vanish within a day.

name: Pompeii
description: Buried Roman city that Vespillo explored with spells.

name: Herculaneum
description: Buried Roman city that Vespillo explored with spells.

name: Catacombs of Rome
description: Catacombs where Vespillo searched for the tombs of the Mercurian priesthood; his companions died there.

name: Rome
description: City where Vespillo lived and whose catacombs he explored; Honos's temples there are destroyed.

name: Greater Alps
description: Region whose hedge magicians Vespillo and Julius attacked, and where a village cult bound spirits.

name: Transylvania
description: Region where Vespillo and Julius waged campaigns against hedge magicians.

name: Mercurian priesthood
description: Ancient priesthood whose tombs Vespillo sought beneath Rome.

name: Etruscans
description: Ancient people whose burial shafts Vespillo explored and whom Lasa Vegoia taught theurgy and divination.

name: All Hallows
description: October 31st, the eve on which Disciples of the Worm usually celebrate their rites.

name: Knights of the Green Stone
description: A cult of Hermetic minnesinger knights who seek the Stone of Creation; founded at the Wartburgskrieg.

name: Green Stone
description: A stone said to have fallen from Heaven, perhaps from Lucifer's brow or carved into the Holy Grail; the Knights of the Green Stone seek it.

name: Minnesingers
description: German knightly poets of the chivalric tradition; a small Mystery Cult of magi exists among them.

name: Courts of Love
description: Formal courtly tradition to which Minnesang belonged.

name: Lucifer
description: Fallen angel; one legend holds that the Green Stone was a gem set in his brow.

name: Michael
description: Archangel whose sword blow is said to have knocked the Green Stone from Lucifer's brow.

name: Holy Grail
description: Sacred relic that some say was carved from the Green Stone.

name: Hubert de Burgh
description: Said to have stolen an invincibility-granting heaven-fallen stone from the royal treasury.

name: Lapidary
description: An 11th-century text by Bishop Marbode of Rennes on the magical use of gems.

name: Marbode of Rennes
description: Bishop who wrote the 11th-century Lapidary.

name: Gervase of Tilbury
description: Defended lapidaries against skeptics.

name: Alfonso the Wise
description: King of Castile and Leon, credited with writing a lapidary.

name: Wartburgskrieg
description: Early 13th-century minnesinger contest at a German court where the Knights of the Green Stone were founded.

name: Gunnar von Falster
description: Danish knight of House Tytalus who founded the Knights of the Green Stone; rumored author of Parzival.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House of Gunnar von Falster; many of its magi join the Knights of the Green Stone.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House whose magi are often drawn to the Knights of the Green Stone.

name: East Prussia
description: Region whose forests hide the regio castle where a maiden told Gunnar of the Green Stone.

name: Regio
description: A supernatural area; the Knights' castle may be a regio with moving entrances.

name: Unicorn
description: Led on an emerald halter by a misshapen dwarf at the founding of the Knights of the Green Stone.

name: Castle of the Grail
description: Knights of the Green Stone headquarters, probably in a Rhine forest and possibly a regio with moving entrances.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal home to the minnesingers and probably to the Castle of the Grail.

name: Green Stone Lore
description: The cult Lore of the Knights of the Green Stone.

name: Free Expression
description: First Virtue taught to Pages of the Knights of the Green Stone.

name: Dutybound
description: Flaw created by the chivalric oaths in the Green Stone Initiation; Honos's feast heals those who have it.

name: Pentecost
description: Feast when new Green Stone Initiates must arrive and the Knights meet.

name: Parzival
description: Wolfram von Eschenbach's epic poem, said to hide an allegory of the Knights and directions to their Grail Castle.

name: Wulfram von Eschenbach
description: Minnesinger credited with Parzival, which Gunnar may have passed to him by magic.

name: Sir Percival
description: Hero of Parzival who quests for the Holy Grail.

name: Gentle Gift
description: Knights of the Green Stone mainly attract magi with this Virtue.

name: The Gift
description: Magical talent that frightens animals such as horses.

name: Music
description: Ability that Green Stone Initiates must study; Aneirin has a score of 12.

name: Etiquette
description: Grace that Knights of the Green Stone must practice.

name: Charm
description: Grace that Knights of the Green Stone must practice.

name: Baltic
description: Shoreline where the Knights follow rumors of the Green Stone; Baltic wizards first summoned Pukis.

name: Levant
description: Region where some Knights of the Green Stone have searched.

name: Loch Leglean
description: Remote region where Knights of the Green Stone quest.

name: Hibernia
description: Remote region where Knights of the Green Stone quest.

name: Iberia
description: Remote region where Knights of the Green Stone quest.

name: Talisman
description: A magus's attuned device; the Knights use their shields, and immortals bind learning into it.

name: Page (Green Stone)
description: First degree of the Knights of the Green Stone, which teaches Free Expression, Performance Magic: Music and Art of Memory.

name: Squire (Green Stone)
description: Middle degree of the Knights of the Green Stone, which teaches Vulgar Alchemy, Hermetic Numerology and Consummate Talisman.

name: Knight (Green Stone)
description: Highest degree of the Knights of the Green Stone, which teaches Planetary Magic, Gemstone focus or Potent Magic and Hermetic True Names.

name: Art of Memory
description: Ancient secret taught to Pages; it replaces Magical Imagination and helps victims of Chnoubis recall events.

name: Vulgar Alchemy
description: Alchemy Virtue taught to Squires of the Green Stone.

name: Hermetic Numerology
description: Virtue taught to Squires; part of the Arithmetic school.

name: Consummate Talisman
description: Virtue taught to Squires of the Green Stone.

name: Major Magical Focus
description: Knights may learn the Gemstones version; magi may have only one Magical Focus.

name: Hermetic True Names
description: Virtue taught to Knights of the Green Stone.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi, all Green Stone Knights belong to it.

name: Immortal magi
description: Magi who became beings of a supernatural realm; they have Might, no longer age and cannot learn without binding it into a talisman.

name: Magic Realm
description: The supernatural realm that the three immortality paths in the book enter.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine realm's influence, which has covered Honos's temples in Rome.

name: Might
description: A realm-based score; beings with Might can use it to resist spells and face Warding spells.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magic resistance; beings with Might use Might or Form + 5x Parma Magica.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Warding spell that affects beings with a Might score.

name: Aging
description: Aging rolls, which immortals stop making.

name: Warping
description: Magical warping, which cannot affect immortals.

name: Twilight
description: Wizard's Twilight, which cannot affect immortals.

name: Great Elixir
description: Virtue that turns a magus into an immortal magical being; The Elixir converts to Lesser and Great Elixir.

name: Lesser Elixir
description: Alchemy Virtue; Fourth Edition The Elixir converts to Lesser and Great Elixir.

name: Binding the Immortal Memory
description: CrMe Mystery enchantment that binds studied experience into an immortal's talisman at level 10 x XP.

name: The Immortal's Grimoire
description: ReVi Mystery enchantment letting a talisman hold a spell so an immortal can cast it normally.

name: Familiar
description: A magus's bonded creature that can follow the magus into immortality if extra vis equal to Bond/5 is added.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power used in transformation rites, pacts, and left by banished Daimons.

name: Ritual spell
description: A spell that an immortal can invest in a talisman as groundwork for The Immortal's Grimoire.

name: Extraordinary Results
description: Chart used for botched spell-binding with Modified Effect, Side Effect and Disaster tables.

name: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
description: A Perdo Vim spell whose damage to Might is used as a comparison.

name: Chirurgy
description: Medical ability added to Recovery Totals.

name: Medicine
description: Medical ability added to Recovery Totals.

name: Hermetic Alchemy
description: Alchemy Virtue carried over directly in conversion.

name: Philosophic Alchemy
description: Alchemy Virtue carried over directly in conversion.

name: Cabal Legacy
description: Virtue that stays the same in conversion.

name: Celestial Magic
description: Astrological Virtue kept in conversion.

name: Periapts
description: Virtue closest to Fourth Edition Astral Magic.

name: Hermetic Divination
description: Separate Mystery magic replacing Augury, where several methods share one Divination Ability; Lasa Vegoia helps initiate it.

name: Dream Magic
description: Virtue replacing Fourth Edition Oneiromancy.

name: Greater Dream Magic
description: Virtue replacing Fourth Edition Oneiromancy along with Dream Magic.

name: Hermetic Dream Interpreter
description: A kind of Hermetic Divination that replaces Dream Interpreter.

name: Hermetic Synthemata
description: Theurgic Virtue suggested for converted thaumaturgists; Daimons can reveal synthemata.

name: Invocation Magic
description: Virtue that, like Names of Power, calls on powers.

name: Hermetic Geometry
description: New Virtue that is part of the Arithmetic school.

name: Arithmetic
description: School of Mystery magic formed by Numerology, Geometry and Architecture.

name: Ceremonial Magic
description: Magical method in ArM5.

name: Sympathetic magic
description: Magical method in ArM5 that grants sympathetic bonuses in Initiation.

name: Mastery
description: Special abilities that replace Mastery Virtues for Formulaic spells.

name: Daimon
description: Powerful unique magical spirits that send Aspects to Earth and make pacts with theurgists.

name: Aspect
description: An independent manifestation a Daimon sends; binding or destroying it does not harm the Daimon.

name: Invoke the Pact of (Daimon)
description: The theurgic rite and gift of vis used to bargain with a Daimon for a service.

name: Chnoubis the Serpent
description: Lion-headed serpent Daimon from the Nile, invoked to spy and scry; his bite forces victims to speak.

name: Gydryty-kom the Giant
description: Albanian hail giant Daimon who swallows spells and hates being called away from his fight with a fog serpent.

name: Hipta the Nurse
description: Shapechanging Daimon, nurse of Dionysus, invoked to lift curses with her Perdo Vim power.

name: Lasa Vegoia the Matron
description: Water nymph Daimon who taught the Etruscans theurgy and divination and can teach theurgy.

name: Portunes
description: Daimon of harbors, keys and locks who can calm a harbor or open magical locks; his feast is the Portunalia.

name: Honos
description: Roman Daimon of military honor who teaches Leadership and gives the Centurions' Feast.

name: Pukis, Dragon of the Hearth
description: Small Baltic hearth-dragon Daimon that steals gifts for its master and makes Ignem vis in ashes.

name: Aneirin the Bard
description: Welsh bard, now a Daimon, author of Y Gododdin; he knows Stonehenge lore and names of power.

name: Dietrich von Bern
description: Daimon of the German hero-king of Bern who guards his dragon-blooded tomb in the Lessini Mountains.

name: Dionysus
description: God nursed by Hipta.

name: Albanians
description: People who once honored Gydryty-kom.

name: Nile
description: River Chnoubis claims as his home.

name: Forum Boarium
description: Place in Rome near Portunes's temple.

name: Portunalia
description: Portunes's feast on August 17th.

name: Legion of Mithras
description: Said to know a surviving shrine where Honos can be invoked.

name: Centurions' Feast
description: Honos's power that feeds 100 and heals those with Dutybound.

name: Andrilikes
description: Theurgist of the Novgorod Tribunal who wrote a ritual to summon Pukis.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Tribunal of the theurgist Andrilikes.

name: Daimonic Adjuration of Pukis
description: Andrilikes's Hermetic ritual that summons Pukis to a sanctum.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose ancient ways Aneirin can describe.

name: Taliesin
description: One of the five great Welsh poets believed to have left Daimons behind.

name: Talhaearn Tad Awen
description: One of the five great Welsh poets believed to have left Daimons behind.

name: Blwchbardd
description: One of the five great Welsh poets believed to have left Daimons behind.

name: Cian
description: One of the five great Welsh poets believed to have left Daimons behind.

name: Y Gododdin
description: Aneirin's famous poem about Mynyddawg's war band.

name: Mynyddawg Mwynfawr
description: Lord of Caereidyn whose 300-strong war band Aneirin praised.

name: Caereidyn
description: Mynyddawg's seat, near Edinburgh.

name: Cambrian Mountains
description: Mountains where Aneirin's tomb lies and his spirit wanders.

name: Bern
description: City where Dietrich was boy-king.

name: Ermenrik
description: Dietrich's uncle, German ruler of Rome, who conquered Bern.

name: Attila the Hun
description: Ruler to whose court Dietrich fled.

name: Siegfried
description: Nibelungen hero in Dietrich's court.

name: Lessini Mountains
description: Mountains where Dietrich's tomb lies.

name: Mount Etna
description: Volcano into which Church legend says Dietrich was thrown.

name: Das Heldenbuch
description: Collection of German romances containing the legend of Dietrich.

name: Languedoc Tribunal
description: Tribunal where Mathematikoi robes resemble Cathar perfecti.

name: Cathars
description: Heretics whose perfecti look like robed Mathematikoi.

name: Leadership
description: Ability that Honos can teach.

name: Magic Lore
description: Ability that Lasa Vegoia and Aneirin possess.

name: Intellego
description: Technique; Chnoubis leaves Intellego vis, and Intellego Vim can see him.

name: Mentem
description: Form of Chnoubis's Might and powers.

name: Auram
description: Form of Gydryty-kom's and Portunes's Might.

name: Animal
description: Form of Hipta's Might.

name: Aquam
description: Form of Lasa Vegoia's Might.

name: Corpus
description: Form of Honos's and Aneirin's Might.

name: Ignem
description: Form of Pukis's Might.

name: Rego
description: Form of Dietrich's Might.

name: Vim
description: Form tied to magic and spirit, shaped as a dodecahedron in Pythagorean lore.

name: Perdo
description: Technique used to destroy spirits, as in Perdo Vim.

name: Creo
description: Technique used by Binding the Immortal Memory (CrMe).

name: Muto
description: Technique; Muto Terram is a suggested focus for alchemists.

name: Terram
description: Form that Pukis's Sneak Thief uses.

name: Imaginem
description: Form of Aneirin's vis and Pukis's invisibility.
